note: Republic Bank's e-Free account has no monthly service charge; a flat 18 dollars a month applies past three in-branch debits a month, which the game's banking, done online, doesn't make.

sources.title: Republic Bank (Trinidad and Tobago), Deposits & Investments Rates & Charges
sources.said: There is no monthly service charge for your e-Free account. e-Free activity Fee – Three (3) free in-branch debits per month. If this is exceeded, a flat monthly fee of $18.00 will apply.
